schema_note: STANDING council. Same conventions as quick-council.json revision 3; only what differs carries comments.
kind_cite: 50:7; constituted by the parent's act — 50:8 if it is to act for the parent or receive automatic referrals, else 50:9 (a standing rule, majority without notice). This council only reports and originates recommendations, so 50:9 governs; for a steward-parent the difference is nominal (feedback-2 §9)
class_of_business: decisions in the ASF in-place refactor where the right answer depends on which part of the system the decider knows best
class_of_business_note: no special council may be seated for a task within this class while this council exists [50:10]

authority.parent_powers: as quick-council.json (including the declared departure from 51:65 for reading the record), plus: refer new matters at any time [50:19]; instruct that the 49:21 informalities not apply [50:26]
authority.DERIVED_on_report: deciders: council seats under delegated authority (grant); decided-by: delegated

roll.desc: DECLARED. Identities as quick-council.json; additionally, across sessions a re-forked occupant is 'absent' under 37:35(2) for votes it did not cast, and the seat stands in for its past occupants in the 'present or notified' tests. Slots assigned at seating.

term.ends: DECLARED: the parent's act, or a named event
term.seat_turnover: a seat re-assigned to a different SOURCE is a term boundary for that seat

seats.perspective: what main actually holds, re-derived rather than remembered
what the event trail can and cannot say
who checks whom; continuity against independence in the loop
what the next cold reader finds first
what the change costs to integrate and what it can break

officers.chair_cite: 13:18; a member-chair restores the sua-sponte duties and a neutral ruling sustained on a tie [24:3(7)], the protection a mechanical chair's submit-to-majority lacks (feedback-2 §9); votes on all questions [49:21(7)] — compiled below

referred_note: referrals arrive as parent events: a subject referral (the council drafts, 51:4), a resolution referral [13:6], or from a parent council a subsidiary commit carrying pending amendments [13:19]

agenda.desc: an ORDER OF BUSINESS (a rule) plus an agenda the council may adopt per session [41:61], changeable only by two-thirds, majority of the entire membership, or unanimous consent [41:63]; parent-referred items are instructions the council cannot drop [13:8(d), 51:37, 52:15]
agenda.referred_items_enter_as: general orders in the order referred [41:23, 41:52], or special orders if the referral sets a reporting round/event [14:14, 41:41-42]

list.value: a report on every referred matter; a periodic report of activity at each term's end

as quick-council.json: the report on a matter is the text of the motion report-referred-matter, debatable and amendable, adopted by majority [51:2]; each report also names what the council left open and under what evidence it would reopen

list.conditions: as quick-council.json: two-thirds; distinct perspective; no vote on questions pending at seating

value.bounds: within the grant; never touching the parent's instructions

list.value: a question carried over to a later sitting whose advisory inputs or referred papers have changed (a lapse on the record it rests on, in vsect's sense) comes up WITH THE LAPSE SHOWN, open to the existing machinery — renewal after progress [38:7], reconsideration [37], rescission [35] — decided by the later majority that can see what moved. Revision 2 put this test inside the corridor predicate, where two guards evaluate it when a postponement is MOVED and the future is unknown (feedback-2 §7); it now acts at the later session, which is 8:12's principle (the later majority's freedom)
the call of the next sitting; notice at a sitting recorded in the minutes [10:50]
the chair, or any two seats, or the parent's referral

never from the parent (declared departure from 51:65, as quick-council.json). [guess] a sitting's debate may by majority be marked closed to OTHER agents' future reading; action taken is always open [9:26]

add.desc: outside the class of business [50:9, 53:9 by analogy]; adjudged, raised by point of order (F17)

excluded_with_reason.motion/reconsider-enter-minutes: served by previous notice across sittings

motion.name: Report a Referred Matter
params: q (a referred question finally disposed of in this council)

applies_to.desc: carries the report's text; debatable and amendable as to it [51:2]; 'rise' is never used in a standing committee [50:23]; bindings declared as precedence.json's reconsider row declares its (feedback-2 §8)

motion.effect: emit the adopted text to the parent as event `reported`; the council continues

electronic_meeting_rules.cite: 9:35-36; the 9:34 departure declared as in quick-council.json
electronic_meeting_rules.equipment: as quick-council.json: the store is isolated; tools are not withheld
electronic_meeting_rules.notice: the call of each sitting names the round backstop, the store location, these rules, and any notice given [10:44-51]
electronic_meeting_rules.presence_and_quorum: roll round at each call to order; maintained by answering; asked/answered recorded
electronic_meeting_rules.recognition: per contention rev 3 §4 step 6; the elected chair's assignment among non-preferred claims follows the same declared devices and is appealable [42:14-15]
electronic_meeting_rules.motions_in_writing: written; the 4:19 targeted round PARKED (serial-floor finding)
electronic_meeting_rules.voting: signed ballot [45:46] classified roll-call; one final ballot per seat; the member-chair votes with the members [49:21(7)]; no change-vote

backstop.wall_clock: DECLARED per sitting in the notice
backstop.recorded_as: a fact with the asked/answered record

electronic_meeting_rules.between_sittings: receive a referral; call a sitting [50:21]; give previous notice; nothing else

logical_time.end-of-session: DERIVED from kind=standing: adjournment of a sitting that set no adjourned sitting [8:4, 8:9]
logical_time.next-regular-session: the next sitting called under calling-a-sitting
logical_time.quarterly-interval: DECLARED, a property of the schedule and the roll only: within-quarterly(s1, s2) ≡ no seat crossed a term boundary between s1 and s2 [9:8, 49:22]. The elapsed-world test lives in instruction lapsed-grounds, evaluated at the later session (feedback-2 §7)
logical_time.current_session: the sitting id when no adjourned sitting was set; else the first sitting of the series
logical_time.last_business_day_of_session: true in a sitting the chair has declared the last of its session
logical_time.adjourned_meeting_set: true when fix-time-to-which-to-adjourn named a round or event
logical_time.hour: a (sitting, round) or an event anchor

rule_stack: as quick-council.json, with special-rules-of-order adoptable within the grant [50:26]

dissolution.DERIVED_from_kind: standing: the parent's act, or the term's end [50:7]; unreported referred matters pass to the successor seats [50:29]

record: as quick-council.json; one log per council; sittings and sessions as records
